Service status checks require running on the homelab network. All port numbers are defaults; actual ports may differ based on docker-compose overrides.\n6|\n7|---\n8|\n9|## 1. Jellyfin\n10|\n11|### Purpose\n12|Free software media streaming server. Organizes, manages, and streams video/audio to any device. Open-source alternative to Plex. Uses ASP.NET Core with Kestrel web server.\n13|\n14|### Default Ports\n15|- HTTP: **8096**\n16|- HTTPS: **8920**\n17|- DLNA: **1900**\n18|- Discovery: **7359/udp**\n19|\n20|### Traefik / Exposure\n21|Typically exposed at `jellyfin.home.wineandgecko.com` via Traefik middleware. Docker labels include `traefik.http.routers.jellyfin.rule=Host(\\`jellyfin.home.wineandgecko.com\\`)`, `traefik.http.routers.jellyfin.tls=true`, `traefik.http.services.jellyfin.loadbalancer.server.port=8096`.\n22|\n23|### API Documentation\n24|- Base URL: `http://<host>:8096/api` (most endpoints are under `/api/`)\n25|- Swagger UI: `http://<host>:8096/api-docs/swagger/index.html`\n26|- ReDoc: `http://<host>:8096/api-docs/redoc/index.html`\n27|- Official docs: https://jellyfin.org/docs/general/developers/api/\n28|- GitHub: https://github.com/jellyfin/jellyfin\n29|\n30|### Auth Method\n31|- **API Key**: `X-Emby-Authorization: MediaBrowser ***\"YOUR_API_KEY\"` header (preferred for service-to-service)\n32|- **Session Token**: `X-Emby-Authorization: MediaBrowser ***\"AppName\", Device=\"DeviceName\", DeviceId=\"uuid\", Version=\"1.0.0\", Token=\"USER_TOKEN\"` header\n33|- **Query param**: `?api_key=<token>` (convenience, less secure)\n34|- No OAuth — self-hosted, single-user model with user profiles\n35|\n36|### Key API Endpoints\n37|\n38|#### Authentication\n39|- `POST /Users/AuthenticateByName` — Login with credentials. Body: `{ Username: \"admin\", Pw: \"password\" }`. Returns `{ AccessToken, User: { Id, Name, Policy: { IsAdministrator, IsHidden, ... } } }`\n40|- `GET /Users/PublicLogin?Username={user}&Password={pass}` — Public login (lighter weight)\n41|- `GET /Users` — List all users (admin only)\n42|- `GET /Users/{userId}` — Get user details\n43|- `GET /Users/Me?api_key={key}` — Get current authenticated user\n44|\n45|#### Library & Media Browsing\n46|- `GET /Users/{userId}/Views` — List all library views (Movies, TV Shows, Music, etc.). Each has `Id`, `Name`, `CollectionType`, `Path`\n47|- `GET /Users/{userId}/Items?ParentId={viewId}&IncludeItemTypes=Movie&Limit=25&SortBy=SortName&SortOrder=Ascending&Fields=PrimaryImage%2CMediaStreams%2COverview%2CDateCreated%2CProductionYear` — Browse items in a library\n48|- `GET /Users/{userId}/Items?SortBy=DateCreated%2CName&SortOrder=Descending&IncludeItemTypes=Movie%2CTvSeries&Limit=12&Fields=PrimaryImage%2COverview%2CMediaStreams` — Recently added items\n49|- `GET /Users/{userId}/Items?SortBy=DatePlayed%2CName&SortOrder=Descending&IncludeItemTypes=Movie%2CTvSeries&Limit=20&Fields=PrimaryImage%2CMediaStreams%2COverview` — Recently watched\n50|- `GET /Users/{userId}/Items?SortBy=PlaybackCount%2CDatePlayed&SortOrder=Descending&Limit=12&IncludeItemTypes=Movie%2CTvSeries&Fields=PrimaryImage%2COverview%2CMediaStreams` — Most played\n51|- `GET /Users/{userId}/Items?Filters=IsUnplayed&IncludeItemTypes=Movie&Limit=20&Fields=PrimaryImage%2COverview` — Unplayed items\n52|- `GET /Users/{userId}/Items/{itemId}/Images/Primary` — Primary image (thumb)\n53|- `GET /Users/{userId}/Items/{itemId}/Images/Backdrop/0` — Backdrop image\n54|- `GET /Users/{userId}/Items/{itemId}/Images/Logo` — Logo image\n55|- `GET /Users/{userId}/Items?SearchTerm={term}&IncludeItemTypes=Movie%2CEpisode&Limit=10&Fields=PrimaryImage` — Search library\n56|- `GET /Users/{userId}/Items?ParentId={seasonId}&IncludeItemTypes=Episode&Limit=100&Fields=PrimaryImage%2COverview%2CMediaStreams` — Get episodes of a season\n57|- `GET /Users/{userId}/Items?ParentId={seriesId}&IncludeItemTypes=Season&Fields=PrimaryImage%2CDateCreated` — Get seasons of a series\n58|- `GET /Users/{userId}/Items?ParentId={seriesId}&IncludeItemTypes=Episode&Fields=PrimaryImage%2CMediaStreams%2COverview&SortBy=IndexNumber&SortOrder=Ascending` — All episodes sorted by index\n59|\n60|#### Playback & Live\n61|- `GET /Sessions` — List active sessions. Each session has: `{ Client, DeviceName, Player: { Product, Version, Platform }, NowPlayingItem: { Id, Name, Type, MediaType, MediaType }, State, PlayState: { PositionTicks, IsPaused }, SupportedCommands }`\n62|- `GET /Sessions/{sessionId}/Playing` — Detailed playback state\n63|- `POST /Sessions/{sessionId}/Playing/Stopped` — Stop playback\n64|- `POST /Sessions/{sessionId}/Playing/Progress` — Report progress. Body: `{ IsPaused, PositionTicks, IsMuted, VolumeLevel }`\n65|- `GET /Users/{userId}/Items/{itemId}/PlaybackInfo` — Get playback info (supported streams, transcoding options)\n66|- `GET /Users/{userId}/Items/{itemId}/Subtitles` — List available subtitles\n67|- `GET /Videos/{itemId}/Subtitles` — List subtitles for video\n68|- `GET /Videos/{itemId}/Stream?streamType=subtitle` — Stream subtitle file\n69|- `GET /Audio/{itemId}/stream?container=mp3&audioBitRate=128000&static=true` — Stream audio (direct or transcode)\n70|- `GET /Videos/{itemId}/master.m3u8` — HLS adaptive streaming\n71|- `GET /Users/{userId}/Items/{itemId}/UserData` — Get play state, rating, favorite status, playback progress\n72|\n73|#### System & Configuration\n74|- `GET /System/Info` — Server info. Returns: `{ ServerName, Version, OperatingSystem, ProcessorInfo, SystemMemoryTotalMegabytes, SystemMemoryUsageMegabytes, StartTimeUtc, LocalAddress, MaxSupportedBitrate, TranscodingHttpHeaderCount (active transcodes), Uptime, StartupWizardCompleted, Id, Configuration: { EnableUPnP, EnableSSL, ... } }`\n75|- `GET /System/ActivityLog?limit=20` — Recent activity log entries\n76|- `GET /ScheduledTasks?StartImmediately=true` — List scheduled tasks (metadata download, library scan, content scanning). Each: `{ Id, Name, Category, Status, CurrentProgressPercentage, IntervalSeconds }`\n77|- `POST /ScheduledTasks/{taskId}/Execute` — Trigger a task immediately\n78|- `GET /Plugins` — List installed plugins\n79|- `GET /Plugins/RemoteImageProviders` — List remote image providers\n80|- `GET /Startup/Config` — Initial setup wizard state\n81|- `GET /Users/{userId}/Items?SortBy=DatePlayed%2CName&SortOrder=Descending&Limit=10&IncludeItemTypes=Movie&Fields=PrimaryImage%2CMediaStreams%2COverview&UserId={userId}` — Recently watched movies\n82|\n83|#### WebSocket\n84|- `ws://<host>:8096/socket?api_key={key}` — Real-time updates for library changes, playback sessions, system messages\n85|\n86|### Data Exposed\n87|- Full media library (movies, TV shows, music, books, photos)\n88|- Playback history, watch status, ratings, resume points\n89|- Active sessions / what's playing everywhere\n90|- User profiles and settings\n91|- Plugin configurations\n92|- System health (CPU, RAM, disk, transcoding status, uptime)\n93|- Scheduled task status\n94|- Activity log\n95|\n96|### Command Deck Integration Idea\n97|**Dashboard: \"Now Playing Everywhere\" + Recently Added + System Health**\n98|\n99|```bash\n100|# Get server health and status\n101|curl -s -H \"X-Emby-Authorization: MediaBrowser ***\"YOUR_API_KEY\\\"\" (.SystemMemoryTotalMegabytes / 1024 | . * 100 | round / 100),\n107|  MemoryUsedGB: (.SystemMemoryUsageMegabytes / 1024 | . * 100 | round / 100),\n108|  ActiveTranscodes: .TranscodingHttpHeaderCount,\n109|  Uptime: .Uptime,\n110|  StartTime: .StartTimeUtc\n111|}'\n112|\n113|# Get all active sessions (who's watching what)\n114|curl -s -H \"X-Emby-Authorization: MediaBrowser ***\"YOUR_API_KEY\\\"\" http://<host>:8096/api/Sessions | jq '.[] | {\n115|  Client: .Client,\n116|  Device: .DeviceName,\n117|  Player: .Player.Product,\n118|  Title: .NowPlayingItem.Name,\n119|  Type: .NowPlayingItem.Type,\n120|  MediaType: .NowPlayingItem.MediaType,\n121|  State: .State,\n122|  ProgressSec: ((.PlayState.PositionTicks // 0) / 10000000),\n123|  IsPaused: (.PlayState.IsPaused // false),\n124|  Volume: .PlayState.VolumeLevel\n125|}'\n126|\n127|# Get recently added items across all libraries\n128|curl -s -H \"X-Emby-Authorization: MediaBrowser ***\"YOUR_API_KEY\\\"\" \\\n129|  \"http://<host>:8096/api/Users/{userId}/Items?SortBy=DateCreated%2CName&SortOrder=Descending&IncludeItemTypes=Movie%2CTvSeries%2CSeason&Limit=12&Fields=PrimaryImage%2COverview%2CMediaStreams%2CProductionYear&UserId={userId}\" | jq '.Items[] | {\n130|  Title: .Name,\n131|  Type: .TypeName,\n132|  Year: .ProductionYear,\n133|  MediaType: .MediaType,\n134|  ImageTag: .ImageTags.Primary\n135|}'\n136|\n137|# Get transcoding status\n138|curl -s -H \"X-Emby-Authorization: MediaBrowser ***\"YOUR_API_KEY\\\"\" http://<host>:8096/api/System/Info | jq '{\n139|  ActiveTranscodes: .TranscodingHttpHeaderCount,\n140|  MemoryTotalGB: (.SystemMemoryTotalMegabytes / 1024),\n141|  MemoryUsedGB: (.SystemMemoryUsageMegabytes / 1024),\n142|  MemoryPercent: ((.SystemMemoryUsageMegabytes / .SystemMemoryTotalMegabytes) * 100 | round)\n143|}'\n144|\n145|# Get unplayed movies (watchlist)\n146|curl -s -H \"X-Emby-Authorization: MediaBrowser ***\"YOUR_API_KEY\\\"\" \\\n147|  \"http://<host>:8096/api/Users/{userId}/Items?Filters=IsUnplayed&IncludeItemTypes=Movie&Limit=20&Fields=PrimaryImage%2COverview%2CProductionYear&UserId={userId}\" | jq '.Items[] | {Title: .Name, Year: .ProductionYear}'\n148|```\n149|\n150|**Value Rating: HIGH** — Core homelab media service. Dashboard needs real-time \"what's playing everywhere\" monitoring, system health, and quick library browsing.\n151|\n152|---\n153|\n154|## 2. Plex Media Server\n155|\n156|### Purpose\n157|Proprietary media streaming server with client apps, remote access, live TV (TVE), and a built-in free content library. Industry standard for media servers.\n158|\n159|### Default Ports\n160|- HTTP: **32400**\n161|- Plex Media Scanner: **32469**\n162|- DLNA: **1900**\n163|- Local discovery: **32410/udp**\n164|\n165|### Traefik / Exposure\n166|Typically exposed at `plex.home.wineandgecko.com` via Traefik. Docker labels include `traefik.http.routers.plex.rule=Host(\\`plex.home.wineandgecko.com\\`)`, `traefik.http.routers.plex.tls=true`, `traefik.http.services.plex.loadbalancer.server.port=32400`.\n167|\n168|### API Documentation\n169|- Base URL: `http://<host>:32400` (no `/api/` prefix — Plex API is flat)\n170|- API Key: `X-Plex-Token` header (required for most endpoints)\n171|- Official API docs: https://forums.plex.tv/t/api-documentation/178865\n172|- Community Python SDK: `plexapi` (https://github.com/pkkid/python-plexapi)\n173|- PlexAPI.dev: https://plexapi.dev/quick-start\n174|\n175|### Auth Method\n176|- `X-Plex-Token: <token>` header (required for authenticated endpoints)\n177|- `X-Plex-Client-Identifier: <unique-client-id>` header (device ID, generated once)\n178|- `X-Plex-Product`, `X-Plex-Version`, `X-Plex-Client-Name`, `X-Plex-Platform`, `X-Plex-Platform-Version` headers (recommended for all requests)\n179|- Plex account auth for remote access\n180|- No OAuth for local use — token-based\n181|\n182|### Key API Endpoints\n183|\n184|#### Authentication & Identity\n185|- `GET /identity?X-Plex-Client-Identifier={device_id}` — Get or create Plex device identity. Returns `{ auth: { X-Plex-Token } }`\n186|- `POST /identity/new` — Force create a new identity\n187|- `GET /identity?X-Plex-Client-Identifier={device_id}` — Get current identity (includes token)\n188|\n189|#### Server & System\n190|- `GET /?X-Plex-Token={token}` — Root endpoint. Returns XML with MediaContainer containing: `{ friendlyName, machineIdentifier, product, productVersion, platform, platformVersion, protocol, vendor }`\n191|- `GET /server/` — Server details\n192|- `GET /system` — System info\n193|- `GET /system/updates?X-Plex-Token={token}` — Check for updates. Returns `{ DownloadURL, Version }`\n194|- `PUT /system/update/next?X-Plex-Token={token}` — Update to next version\n195|- `GET /system/storage?X-Plex-Token={token}` — Storage/disk info. Returns list of mounts: `{ mountPath, type, total, free }`\n196|- `GET /:/prefs` — Get all server preferences (XML)\n197|- `GET /system/languages?X-Plex-Token={token}` — Available languages\n198|\n199|#### Active Sessions (NOW PLAYING)\n200|- `GET /status/sessions?X-Plex-Token={token}` — **All active sessions** (most important endpoint)\n201|  - Returns XML with `<Video>` or `<Track>` elements inside `<MediaContainer>`\n202|  - Each has: `type`, `grandparentTitle`, `title`, `thumb`, `userTitle`, `viewOffset`, `duration`, `librarySectionID`, `librarySectionTitle`, `grandparentRatingKey`, `grandparentKey`, `grandparentThumb`, `grandparentArt`, `grandparentTheme`, `thumbKey`, `art`, `audienceRating`, `audienceRatingImage`, `rating`, `contentRating`, `summary`, `tagline`, `audienceRatingImage`, `viewCount`, `lastViewedAt`, `year`, `originallyAvailableAt`, `originallyAvailableAtApp`, `addedAt`, `updatedAt`, `Player: { address, device, local, product, relayed, secure, title, userID }`, `Session: { id, bandwidth, key }`, `User: { id, thumb, title }`\n203|  - If transcoding: `<TranscodeSession>` with `key`, `progress`, `speed`, `duration`, `remaining`, `context`, `sourceVideoCodec`, `sourceAudioCodec`, `videoDecision`, `audioDecision`, `protocol`, `transcodeUnPipelinedCount`, `timeActivated`\n204|- `GET /status/sessions?type=movie` — Filter to video only\n205|- `GET /status/sessions?type=episode` — Filter to episodes only\n206|- `GET /status/sessions?type=track` — Filter to music only\n207|- `GET /status/sessions?X-Plex-Token={token}` — Returns `<MediaContainer size=\"N\">` with `<Video>` or `<Track>` children\n208|\n209|#### Library\n210|- `GET /library/sections?X-Plex-Token={token}` — List all library sections. Each: `<Directory key=\"{id}\" type=\"{movie|show|artist|photo}\" title=\"{Name}\" allowSync=\"{0|1}\" art=\"...\" filters=\"1\" refreshing=\"0\" thumb=\"...\">`\n211|- `GET /library/sections/{sectionId}/all?X-Plex-Token={token}` — All items in a section (paginated with `X-Plex-Container-Start` and `X-Plex-Container-Size`)\n212|- `GET /library/sections/{sectionId}/recentlyAdded?X-Plex-Token={token}` — Recently added items\n213|- `GET /library/sections/{sectionId}/recentlyViewed?X-Plex-Token={token}` — Recently viewed\n214|- `GET /library/sections/{sectionId}/onDeck?X-Plex-Token={token}` — On deck (continue watching)\n215|- `GET /library/recentlyAdded?X-Plex-Token={token}` — Recently added across all libraries\n216|- `GET /library/onDeck?X-Plex-Token={token}` — On deck across all libraries\n217|- `GET /library/metadata/{itemId}/children?X-Plex-Token={token}` — Get children (episodes of a show)\n218|- `GET /library/metadata/{itemId}/allLeaves?X-Plex-Token={token}` — All episodes of a season\n219|- `GET /library/metadata/{itemId}/recentlyViewed?X-Plex-Token={token}` — Recently viewed episodes\n220|- `GET /library/metadata/{itemId}/reviews?X-Plex-Token={token}` — Get reviews\n221|- `GET /library/metadata/{itemId}/markPlayed?X-Plex-Token={token}` — Mark as played\n222|- `GET /library/metadata/{itemId}/markUnplayed?X-Plex-Token={token}` — Mark as unplayed\n223|- `GET /library/metadata/{itemId}?X-Plex-Token={token}` — Get metadata for specific item\n224|- `GET /library/sections/{sectionId}/firstCharacter?X-Plex-Token={token}` — Get first character index for browsing\n225|- `GET /library/sections/{sectionId}/firstCharacter/{char}/children?X-Plex-Token={token}` — Items starting with char\n226|- `GET /library/sections/{sectionId}/refresh?X-Plex-Token={token}` — Refresh library scan\n227|\n228|#### Playback Control\n229|- `POST /playQueues?uri={uri}&X-Plex-Token={token}` — Create a play queue\n230|- `GET /playQueues/{id}?X-Plex-Token={token}` — Get play queue\n231|- `DELETE /transcode/sessions/{key}?X-Plex-Token={token}` — Kill a transcode session\n232|- `GET /transcode/sessions?X-Plex-Token={token}` — List active transcode sessions\n233|- `POST /scrobble?identifier=com.plexapp.plugins.library&id={itemId}&key=/library/metadata/{itemId}&state={playing|stopped}&X-Plex-Token={token}` — Scrobble playback\n234|\n235|#### Live TV (if Plex Pass)\n236|- `GET /live/tv?X-Plex-Token={token}` — List live TV channels\n237|- `GET /live/tv/now?X-Plex-Token={token}` — What's on now\n238|- `GET /live/tv/upcoming?X-Plex-Token={token}` — What's coming up\n239|- `GET /live/tv/recordings?X-Plex-Token={token}` — Recorded shows\n240|- `GET /live/tv/recordings?limit=20&X-Plex-Token={token}` — Recent recordings\n241|- `POST /live/tv/recordings?uri={uri}&X-Plex-Token={token}` — Record a show\n242|\n243|#### Search\n244|- `GET /library/search?query={term}&includeMetadadata=1&limit=20&X-Plex-Token={token}` — Search library\n245|- `GET /library/search?query={term}&limit=20&media={movie|show|artist|photo}&X-Plex-Token={token}` — Filtered search\n246|\n247|### Response Format\n248|- **Default**: XML (Plex's native format)\n249|- **JSON**: Add `Accept: application/json` header\n250|- XML root: `<MediaContainer size=\"N\">` with typed children (`<Directory>`, `<Video>`, `<Track>`, `<TranscodeSession>`)\n251|\n252|### Data Exposed\n253|- Full media library with metadata\n254|- Active sessions with detailed playback state (volume, position, bitrate, resolution, transcode info)\n255|- Playback history and watch status\n256|- Live TV guide and recordings\n257|- Channel lineup and schedule\n258|- User profiles and activity\n259|- System health and storage\n260|- Update availability\n261|- Play queues\n262|- Server preferences\n263|\n264|### Command Deck Integration Idea\n265|**Dashboard: \"What's Playing Everywhere\" + On Deck + System + Update Status**\n266|\n267|```bash\n268|# Get all active sessions with detailed playback info (JSON)\n269|curl -s -H \"X-Plex-Token: YOUR_TOKEN\" -H \"Accept: application/json\" \\\n270|  http://<host>:32400/status/sessions | jq '.MediaContainer.Metadata[] | {\n271|  Type: .type,\n272|  Title: .grandparentTitle + \" - \" + .title,\n273|  User: .user.title,\n274|  ViewerCount: .viewerCount,\n275|  Client: .player.product + \" on \" + .player.device,\n276|  Address: .player.address,\n277|  Progress: .viewOffset + \" / \" + .duration,\n278|  ProgressPct: ((.viewOffset / .duration) * 100 | round),\n279|  Stream: .Media[0].videoResolution + \"p @\" + .Media[0].bitrate + \"kbps\",\n280|  Transcode: (if .transcodeSession then \"Transcoding @\" + .transcodeSession.speed + \"x\" else \"Direct Play\" end),\n281|  Location: .session.location\n282|}'\n283|\n284|# Get on-deck (continue watching) across all libraries\n285|curl -s -H \"X-Plex-Token: YOUR_TOKEN\" -H \"Accept: application/json\" \\\n286|  http://<host>:32400/library/onDeck | jq '.MediaContainer.Directory[] | {\n287|  Title: .title,\n288|  Type: .type,\n289|  Grandparent: .grandparentTitle,\n290|  Progress: .viewOffset + \" / \" + .duration,\n291|  Thumb: .thumb\n292|}'\n293|\n294|# Get system/storage info\n295|curl -s -H \"X-Plex-Token: YOUR_TOKEN\" -H \"Accept: application/json\" \\\n296|  http://<host>:32400/system/storage | jq '.MediaContainer.Directory[] | {\n297|  Mount: .mountPath,\n298|  Type: .type,\n299|  TotalGB: (.total / 1073741824 | . * 100 | round / 100),\n300|  FreeGB: (.free / 1073741824 | . * 100 | round / 100),\n301|  UsedPct: ((.free / .total) * 100 | round)\n302|}'\n303|\n304|# Check for updates\n305|curl -s -H \"X-Plex-Token: YOUR_TOKEN\" -H \"Accept: application/json\" \\\n306|  http://<host>:32400/system/updates | jq '.MediaContainer.Directory[] | {\n307|  Version: .version,\n308|  DownloadURL: .downloadURL,\n309|  Installed: .installed\n310|}'\n311|\n312|# Get library summary\n313|curl -s -H \"X-Plex-Token: YOUR_TOKEN\" -H \"Accept: application/json\" \\\n314|  http://<host>:32400/library/sections | jq '.MediaContainer.Directory[] | {\n315|  Type: .type,\n316|  Title: .title,\n317|  Count: .count,\n318|  Refreshing: .refreshing\n319|}'\n320|\n321|# Kill a transcode session\n322|curl -s -X DELETE -H \"X-Plex-Token: YOUR_TOKEN\" \\\n323|  \"http://<host>:32400/transcode/sessions/{sessionKey}\" | jq '{Status: .message}'\n324|```\n325|\n326|**Value Rating: HIGH** — Most feature-rich media server. Dashboard integration is critical for real-time playback monitoring, live TV, and system management.\n327|\n328|---\n329|\n330|## 3. Navidrome Music Server\n331|\n332|### Purpose\n333|Self-hosted music streaming server. Streams music from your collection to any device. Web-based UI, supports mobile apps, and integrates with Subsonic-compatible clients. Written in Go.\n334|\n335|### Default Ports\n336|- HTTP: **4533**\n337|- gRPC: **4534**\n338|\n339|### Traefik / Exposure\n340|Typically exposed at `navidrome.home.wineandgecko.com` via Traefik. Docker labels include `traefik.http.routers.navidrome.rule=Host(\\`navidrome.home.wineandgecko.com\\`)`, `traefik.http.routers.navidrome.tls=true`, `traefik.http.services.navidrome.loadbalancer.server.port=4533`.\n341|\n342|### API Documentation\n343|- Base URL: `http://<host>:4533` (API endpoints under `/rest/`)\n344|- API Key: Subsonic protocol — `u` (username) and `t` (token) query params\n345|- Subsonic-compatible API: https://www.subsonic.org/projects/api/documentation\n346|- Navidrome Subsonic docs: https://www.navidrome.org/docs/developers/subsonic-api/\n347|- OpenSubsonic extensions: https://github.com/navidrome/navidrome/issues/2695\n348|\n349|### Auth Method\n350|- **Subsonic protocol**: `u` (username) and `t` (generated token) as query params or `Authorization: Bearer *** header\n351|- **Basic auth**: `Authorization: Basic <base6...d)>`\n352|- No OAuth — self-hosted, API key based\n353|- Token generated at `/rest/login?username={user}&password={pass}&_={timestamp}`\n354|\n355|### Key API Endpoints (Subsonic API)\n356|\n357|#### Authentication\n358|- `GET /rest/login?username={user}&password={pass}&_={timestamp}` — Login, returns `{ status: \"success\", token: \"generated_token\" }`\n359|- `GET /rest/ping?u={user}&t={token}&s={app}&v={version}&c={client}&f=json` — Ping to verify token. Returns `{ status: \"success\" }`\n360|\n361|#### Music Playback & Streaming\n362|- `GET /rest/stream?u={user}&t={token}&s={app}&v={version}&c={client}&f=json&id={file}&r={resize}&sft={format}` — Stream audio file\n363|- `GET /rest/stream?u={user}&t={token}&s={app}&v={version}&c={client}&f=json&id={file}` — Direct stream (no transcoding)\n364|- `GET /rest/getDownload?u={user}&t={token}&s={app}&v={version}&c={client}&f=json&id={file}` — Download file\n365|- `GET /rest/getCoverArt?id={id}&s={size}` — Get cover art (returns image)\n366|- `GET /rest/getLyrics?u={user}&t={token}&s={app}&v={version}&c={client}&f=json&artist={artist}&title={title}` — Get lyrics\n367|\n368|#### Library Browsing\n369|- `GET /rest/getAlbumList?u={user}&t={token}&s={app}&v={version}&c={client}&f=json&type=newest&size=12` — Recently added albums\n370|- `GET /rest/getAlbumList?u={user}&t={token}&s={app}&v={version}&c={client}&f=json&type=frequent&size=12` — Most played albums\n371|- `GET /rest/getAlbumList?u={user}&t={token}&s={app}&v={version}&c={client}&f=json&type=highest&size=12` — Highest rated\n372|- `GET /rest/getAlbumList?u={user}&t={token}&s={app}&v={version}&c={client}&f=json&type=starred&size=12` — Starred albums\n373|- `GET
